transit.description:
Hollis, Queens Village, Elmont-UBS Arena, and Floral Park continue to be served by Huntington trains.

Bus service connects Stewart Manor, Nassau Blvd, Garden City, and Hempstead stations to trains at Mineola.

There is no service at Bellerose or Country Life Press. Use nearby Floral Park, Garden City, or Mineola stations instead.

The last normal trains to run on Friday evening are the 9:46pm from Grand Central and the 10:45pm from Hempstead. Service resumes with the 12:52am from Grand Central and the 2:03am from Hempstead on Monday morning.

What's happening?
Concrete tie installation
